82  THE SAVOY MALE AND FEMALE COLLEGE

SIXTH.

The State of Texas } It is remembered that on the 13th
County of Fannin  } day of December A.D. 1884 before me
the undersigned, a Notary Public in and for said County and State of Texas, personally appeared J. T. [P.] Altsberg [Altsberg]; Pres., E. M. [H.] Prince; Vice Pres., B. M. [H.] Stacy; Sec'y.

Witness my hand and seal of office at Savoy this the 13th day of December A.D. 1884.

G. G. Lindsey
Notary Public, Fannin County, Texas

Charter Platonian Literary Society
Filed in the Department of State
Dec. 7, A D 1884

That the Society carried out the coeducational plan of the College is shown by the officers listed for 1886, which are taken from the Platonian of April 1, 1886, which shows that two officers of the Platonian's newly elected officers were women:

March 10, 1886.—The Platonian Literary Society elected the following officers: President, [name illegible]; vice-president, Miss Jennie Lacy; Secretary, Miss[?] Louise[?]; treasurer, R. F. Nichett; sergeant-at-arms, J. D. Warren; librarian, W. G. Brown; chorister, B. Betts; sergeant, W. C. Dean.

Witness my hand and seal of office at Savoy this the
10th day of March A.D. 1886.

G. G. Lindsey
Notary Public, Fannin County, Texas
notes: Page 82 of printed book. Contains notarized charter text and officer list for Platonian Literary Society. Some names partially illegible in scan.
